message.content:
A standard **McDonald’s Big Mac** sold in the United States typically contains **about 550 kcal** (≈ 2,300 kJ).

> *Nutrition fact sheet – U.S.*  
> • Calories: 550 kcal  
> • Protein: 25 g  
> • Total fat: 28 g  
> • Carbohydrates: 45 g  

*(Values come from McDonald’s corporate nutrition database.)*

### Quick notes

| Item | Typical content |
|------|----------------|
| Two 100‑% pure beef patties | 170 kcal each |
| Special “secret” sauce | ≈ 70 kcal |
| Lettuce, tomato, onion, pickle | < 10 kcal |
| Cheese slice | ≈ 50 kcal |
| Sesame‑seed bun (two halves) | ≈ 200–250 kcal |

These numbers represent the average composition used in most U.S. locations. In some international markets the recipe varies slightly—different buns, sauces, or portion sizes—which can shift the total caloric value up or down by roughly ±20 kcal. If you’re tracking your intake precisely, check the local McDonald’s menu or ask staff for the exact nutrition label at the outlet where you order.
